name: KBC Electronics
old_description: Since 1986, KBC Electronics has created a solid reputation with both the industry and its clients. KBC considers itself an extension of our client’s OEM facilities, and we welcome active interaction during the entire relationship.
about:
KBC Electronics was founded in 1986 in Milford, Connecticut. The company operates as a contract manufacturer specializing in electronic circuit board assembly, repair, and related services for original equipment manufacturers.

The firm provides a range of assembly processes including automated surface-mount assembly, box-build integration, prototype and production runs, component sourcing, conformal coating, and quick-turn services. It also offers electronic circuit repair, track modification and rewiring, QFN/DFN placement, and new product development support. The facility maintains ISO 9001 and RoHS certifications.

KBC serves customers in the medical, commercial, and industrial sectors. Its project gallery references medical-grade power supplies, air-flow control systems for hospitals and vivariums, audio/visual equipment, and instrument panel lighting. The company also works with laboratories, clean rooms, and other controlled environments.

KBC positions itself as an extension of its clients' OEM facilities, emphasizing active collaboration throughout the project lifecycle and a commitment to delivering on promises with a focus on quality and customer satisfaction.
